description: Plan 9.3 acceptance (X2.2). One model, two independent subsystems: `Iconic` is a series RLC driven by a 1 V step; `Bondgraph` is Se -> 1-junction with R, I and C. R = 10 Ohm, L = 10 mH, C = 100 uF, so w0 = 1000 rad/s and zeta = 0.5. The capacitor voltage analytically peaks at 1 + exp(-pi*zeta/sqrt(1-zeta^2)) = 1.163034 V (16.303 % overshoot). `compare_signals` is the same-run form of the two-model `compare`; `no_diagnostics` fails only on the listed codes, so the expected W205 of the pure bond-graph island is allowed.

checks.note: peak of the 1 V step response at t = 3.62768 ms; measured 16.303 % overshoot. Analytic 1.16303353482 V; the 1e-3 V band is the plan's 16.3 % +/- 0.1 %.
the bond-graph C stores the same capacitor voltage and peaks at the same instant
the two forms share one IR and must agree within 1e-8 V
SCAP gives integral causality on both storage elements; W205 is expected for the pure Generic bond island
